SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, '高频评论' AS type, COUNT(c.id) * 10 AS score, NOW() AS time, CASE WHEN COUNT(c.id) >= 20 THEN '严重' WHEN COUNT(c.id) >= 10 THEN '高风险' ELSE '中风险' END AS status FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN comments c ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
GROUP BY u.user_id HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= 10 UNION ALL SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, '频繁交互' AS type, COUNT(i.id) * 8 AS score, NOW() AS time, CASE WHEN COUNT(i.id) >= 30 THEN '严重' WHEN COUNT(i.id) >= 15 THEN '高风险' ELSE '中风险' END AS status FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN user_interactions i ON u.user_id = i.user_id WHERE i.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
GROUP BY u.user_id HAVING COUNT(i.id) >= 15 ORDER BY score DESC

SELECT c.id, u.user_name, CONCAT('短时间内发布 ', COUNT(c.id), ' 条评论') AS action, CASE WHEN COUNT(c.id) >= 20 THEN '严重' WHEN COUNT(c.id) >= 10 THEN '高' ELSE '中' END AS risk_level, NOW() AS time FROM sys_user u JOIN comments c ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
GROUP BY u.user_id HAVING COUNT(c.id) >= 10 UNION ALL SELECT i.id, u.user_name, CONCAT('短时间内 ', COUNT(i.id), ' 次点赞/收藏') AS action, CASE WHEN COUNT(i.id) >= 30 THEN '严重' WHEN COUNT(i.id) >= 15 THEN '高' ELSE '中' END AS risk_level, NOW() AS time FROM sys_user u JOIN user_interactions i ON u.user_id = i.user_id WHERE i.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
AND u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
GROUP BY u.user_id HAVING COUNT(i.id) >= 15 ORDER BY risk_level DESC
